components.name: PhaseAttentionLayer
components.family: complex-valued diagonal linear recurrence (Mamba/RWKV/RetNet class); no softmax
components.recurrence: S_t = cumsum_t(k_t v_t^T) or parallel_ema_scan(kv, gamma); out_t = Re(q_t . S_t)/clamp(a_q * cumsum(a_k), 0.1); k=a_k e^{-i phi_k}, q=a_q e^{+i phi_q}, phi=pi*sin(phi_raw)
components.state_shape: [B,1,H,D_h] complex + [B,1,H,D_h] real normalizer -- BOUNDED, constant in N
components.decode: true O(1) recurrent in isolation (forward_chunk / PhaseStateCache)
components.maturity: IMPLEMENTED; validated <=2.4e-7 vs lightweight ref; no trained-LM checkpoints
components.evidence: micro-scale PPL/fluency gain (2M params, 3 seeds); NO retrieval; decorative in hybrids

components.name: LightweightPhaseAttention
components.family: faithful O(N) complex recurrence with explicit bounded PhaseState and register_shape audit guards
components.maturity: FROZEN v1.0; 98 tests; equivalence oracle for production Phase

components.name: BindingCachePhaseState
components.family: key-side-only complex linear recurrence (accumulate KV into state)
components.maturity: IMPLEMENTED; docstring ablation percentages (-50%/~0%) are editorial, not code-derivable

components.name: BindingCacheQuadQuery
components.family: QUADRATIC softmax attention (Q from tokens, K/V from Phase memory) with optional Top-K
components.nxn_evidence: line 3686 scores=matmul(Q,K^T) [B,H,N,N]; line 3690-3694 triu(ones(N,N)) mask; line 3712-3713 topk OVER the materialized matrix; line 3731 V_expanded [B,H,N,N,D_h]. Top-K only narrows softmax width, NOT score construction.
components.actual_complexity: O(N^2) time + O(N^2*D_h) memory (docstring 'O(nk)'/'reduces O(n^2) to O(nk)' at 3511/3699/4121 is FALSE as implemented)
components.maturity: IMPLEMENTED; REJECTED by phase_lc A/B/C ladder (violates no-quadratic rule); replaced by BindingSlots

components.name: LocalWindowAttention (production)
components.family: windowed causal softmax
components.nxn_evidence: line 3838 scores=matmul(Q,K^T) [B,H,N,N] + full N×N windowed mask 3842-3852; contradicts its 'O(n*w)' docstring at 3874
components.maturity: IMPLEMENTED (mislabeled complexity)

components.name: LocalAttention (7B local layers)
components.family: windowed attention, 3 backends
components.nxn_evidence: flash backend O(n*w) (5248-5253); sdpa/unfold build N×N mask, admitted 'still O(n^2) in mask creation' at 5266
components.maturity: IMPLEMENTED

components.name: BindingCacheBlock / BindingCacheTransformer
components.family: per-block additive: local_out (N×N) + memory_state (O(N)) + mem_out (N×N)
components.decode: NO KV/state cache; full-prefix replay (forward always runs full [B,N])
components.maturity: IMPLEMENTED; no committed checkpoints

components.name: OntologicalBindingCacheTransformer
components.family: BindingCacheTransformer + 32D Sovereign State (Bhava/Kosha/Vritti/Guna)
components.maturity: IMPLEMENTED (static audit only, no retraining run)

components.name: HybridAttentionLayer / HybridTransformerBlock / HybridPhaseTransformer
components.family: Protected-Phase serial: x -> Phase -> Local(queries phase out); optional GCT/SlotMemory bolt-on
components.decode: FULL-PREFIX REPLAY when local_layers>0 (default). O(1) recurrent path only for local_layers==0, which NO shipped config uses.
components.decode_evidence: forward_with_cache line 7746-7752: if local_layers>0 -> cache.append_tokens + self.forward(full_input_ids). Config default local_layers=4; 7B uses local_layers=16.
components.actual_decode_complexity: O(prefix_len)/token => O(N^2) to generate N tokens (O(N^3) with sdpa/unfold local backend)
components.maturity: IMPLEMENTED; trained via train_unified_llm_clean.py; no committed checkpoints

components.name: SlotMemoryGCT
components.family: bounded content-addressable KV slot memory, competitive EMA write, top-k hard routing (STE), semantic coherence gate
components.maturity: IMPLEMENTED; training-time module (slots re-init per forward; no decode persistence wired)
components.slot_directive_disposition: independent audit; current evidence supports only fragile single-fact recall

components.name: BoundedBindingSlots (clean)
components.family: bounded content-addressed slots with full metadata
components.maturity: IMPLEMENTED + hook-verified no-N×N; the only slot impl with source/version/supersession/eviction
components.slot_directive_disposition: candidate auxiliary memory pending multi-seed thresholds

components.name: GCT (Gated Coherence Transformer)
components.family: SEPARATE architecture: O(n^2) softmax + pre-softmax coherence gating + lambda-ladder insulation; NOT Phase, NOT O(n)
components.maturity: IMPLEMENTED v1 (design doc March 2026); run_gct_training.sh
components.flag: name misleads: shipped beside Phase/'hybrid' but is a distinct quadratic architecture

components.name: hybrid_token_event_attention
components.family: token path (Mistral-native) + bounded event path (K<=16 EvidenceRecord slots, softmax); learned (event_attention.py) AND rule-based (deterministic_event_reasoner.py) forms
components.measured_benefit: governed event path H3 +0.63 vs vanilla token, +0.38 retrieval-text; event-to-event interaction marginal (+0.017 all/+0.046 relational, under +0.05 bar); deterministic H4=1.000 on oracle
components.maturity: EXECUTED (pure-stdlib autograd, CPU); RM1 real-Mistral harness RESOURCE_BLOCKED

components.name: SemanticRouter
components.family: routes a query to internal specialized 7B sub-models by phoneme/ontology signature
components.maturity: IMPLEMENTED

components.name: hybrid_handover
components.family: small-model(O(n) on-prem)->frontier-API handover scaffold with grounding/faithfulness/redaction gates; in-house tier is a DETERMINISTIC RULES stand-in, not a neural model
components.maturity: Runnable scaffold; ~427x egress reduction demoed

components.name: LLM Steering Controller (CRS)
components.family: deterministic meaning-frame steering + audit layer; explicitly not a smarter model, no weight changes
components.maturity: Doc/brief-led; predictive track parked

components.name: Model Selection Policy (MSP)
components.family: policy engine choosing among APPROVED PROVIDER models by cost/eligibility/regret; not architecture, not handover
components.maturity: EXECUTED (arm F regret 0.016 vs 0.055 baseline); synthetic
components.flag: must NOT be merged with Hybrid LLM (#9)

components.name: train_unified_llm.py
components.family: thin re-export of symbolu.training.unified.train; create_model dispatches on model_type; DEFAULT model_type='ontological' -> SymbolU12LLMWithBhava, NOT Phase/Hybrid
components.maturity: shim over symbolu_training/training/unified/ + monolith train_unified_llm_clean.py (837 KB)
